name: quimera
description: QUIMERA — Axie Vibeathon 2026 entry. You are the Chimera: hunt Axies, graft their parts, become the monster.

scripts.build:deploy: tsc --noEmit && QUIMERA_DEPLOY=1 vite build --outDir dist-next && node scripts/prune-assets.mjs --copy dist-next/assets/axie && mkdir -p dist-next/data && cp public/data/axies.json dist-next/data/ && ([ -d public/audio ] && cp -R public/audio dist-next/audio || true) && cp vercel.json dist-next/ && rm -rf dist && mv dist-next dist
